# Holdout fixture corpus (SYNTHETIC, development-time)

Generated by `tools/evaluate_holdout.py --generate` from `skill/knowledge/languages/` (one vulnerable + one safe file per card). Layout: `<language>/<card-id>_{vuln,safe}.<ext>`.

**Isolation warning:** these files are derived from the same synthetic snippets the detection signals were authored against, so they measure pipeline wiring and regression only. They are NOT an independent holdout set and must never be cited as generalization evidence. A true holdout corpus must be written independently by maintainers, kept out of all tuning loops, and versioned separately.
